subject: version 2.2.1 of AICcmodavg package now on CRAN

messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: version 2.2.1 of AICcmodavg package now on CRAN
parts:
Hi,

The new version (2.2.1) of the AICcmodavg package is now on CRAN. You'll find below a summary of the changes and new functionalities potentially of interest to unmarked users.

Major changes:

- new function 'summaryOD' to compute confidence intervals around estimates (out.type = "confint") or hypothesis tests (out.type = "nhst") adjusted for overdispersion on models using the Poisson or binomial distributions (xtable method created to output to LaTeX).

- new function 'anovaOD' to compute likelihood ratio tests corrected for overdispersion between two models of various classes that use the Poisson or binomial distributions (xtable method created to output to LaTeX).

- package now supports multispecies occupancy data and models of classes 'unmarkedFrameOccuMulti' and 'unmarkedFitOccuMulti' (for all functions except modavgPred)

- package now fully supports the false positive occupancy models, including the "b" parameter for certain detections

- there is now a 'parallel' argument in 'Nmix.gof.test' and 'mb.gof.test' to control the 'parallel' argument in 'parboot'

- 'mb.chisq' and 'mb.gof.test' now support Royle-Nichols models fit with 'occuRN' (thanks to Dan Linden)

- new functions 'ictab' and 'modavgIC' to do model selection or multimodel inference for information criteria other than AIC, AICc, QAIC, or QAICc. This requires the user to supply a vector of information criteria (e.g., WAIC, DIC).


Minor changes:

- modified default printing of NA to "." for nicer display in 'detHist', 'countDist', 'mb.chisq', with 'xtable'

- modified 'xtable' for nicer printing of K for 'aictab', 'bictab', and 'anovaOD'


Sincerely,

Marc
